description: This file contains utility functions, mock transaction data, mock network transaction classes, and helper functions for testing HTTP transactions within the Chromium net/http testing framework.

classes.name: MockHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents a mock HTTP request used in testing, constructed from a MockTransaction.

classes.name: TestTransactionConsumer
classes.description: Consumes a mock HTTP transaction, manages its lifecycle, and collects response data.

classes.name: MockNetworkTransaction
classes.description: Simulates a network transaction for testing, providing controlled responses and behaviors.

classes.name: MockNetworkLayer
classes.description: Simulates a network layer that creates mock network transactions for testing.

classes.name: ConnectedHandler
classes.description: Handles connection events in the mock network environment.

methods.name: DefaultTransportInfo
methods.description: Returns default transport information for direct localhost connection.

methods.name: FindMockTransaction
methods.description: Finds a mock transaction matching a given URL.

methods.name: AddMockTransaction
methods.description: Adds a mock transaction to the global mock transaction map.

methods.name: RemoveMockTransaction
methods.description: Removes a mock transaction from the global mock transaction map.

methods.name: MockHttpRequest::MockHttpRequest
methods.description: Constructs a mock HTTP request from a given MockTransaction.

methods.name: MockHttpRequest::CacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for the mock request.

methods.name: TestTransactionConsumer::Start
methods.description: Starts the transaction and begins reading response data.

methods.name: TestTransactionConsumer::DidStart
methods.description: Handles the completion of transaction start.

methods.name: TestTransactionConsumer::DidRead
methods.description: Handles data read from the transaction.

methods.name: TestTransactionConsumer::DidFinish
methods.description: Handles the completion of the transaction.

methods.name: TestTransactionConsumer::Read
methods.description: Initiates a read operation on the transaction.

methods.name: TestTransactionConsumer::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback for I/O completion during read.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::Start
methods.description: Starts the mock network transaction.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::RestartIgnoringLastError
methods.description: Stub for restarting transaction ignoring last error.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::RestartWithCertificate
methods.description: Stub for restarting transaction with client certificate.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Restarts transaction with authentication credentials.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Stub for populating network error details.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::IsReadyToRestartForAuth
methods.description: Checks if transaction is ready to restart for auth.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the mock transaction.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::StopCaching
methods.description: Stops caching for the transaction.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::DoneReading
methods.description: Marks reading as done.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns response info.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::SetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Stub for setting QUIC server info.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Provides load timing info.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Returns remote endpoint info.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::SetPriority
methods.description: Sets request priority.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::SetWebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper
methods.description: Sets WebSocket handshake helper.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::StartInternal
methods.description: Internal method to start transaction based on mock data.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::SetBeforeNetworkStartCallback
methods.description: Sets callback before network start.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::SetConnectedCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for connection events.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::ResumeNetworkStart
methods.description: Resumes network start if paused.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns connection attempts (stub).

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::CloseConnectionOnDestruction
methods.description: Stub for closing connection on destruction.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::CallbackLater
methods.description: Posts callback to run later.

methods.name: MockNetworkTransaction::RunCallback
methods.description: Runs the callback with result.

methods.name: MockNetworkLayer::CreateTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new mock network transaction.
